nodes.description: uint256 public _currentIndex; the tokenId/index of the next lottery to be created
uint256 public _lottoAddressCounter; monotonic counter used to assign a numeric id to each unique participant address
mapping(uint256 => address) counterToAddress; resolves a participant counter back to an address
mapping(address => uint256) addressToCounter; resolves a participant address to its counter
mapping(uint256 => uint256) lottoPrice; ticket price per lottery index
mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) addressPool; list of participant counters entered in each lottery (random winner source)
mapping(uint256 => uint256) ticketsPurchased; number of tickets sold per lottery
mapping(uint256 => uint256) ticketsSupply; maximum tickets per lottery
mapping(uint256 => address) lottoWinner; recorded winner / lottery-ended marker
TuskCoinV2 tuskCoinV2; external token contract used for payment and balance lookup
ITuskCoinV1 tusckCoinV1; external legacy token contract used for burning
totalSupply() returns _currentIndex inside an unchecked block
buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2(uint64 _index, uint64 _amount) public; buys tickets paying with TuskCoinV2
buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1(uint64 _index, uint64 _amount) public payable; buys tickets by burning TuskCoinV1
viewWinner(uint64 _index) view returns the recorded winner address
createLottery(uint64 _ticketMaxSupply, uint256 _price) onlyOwner; creates a new lottery
setLotteryTicketPrice(uint64 _index, uint256 _price) onlyOwner; updates a lottery price
drawLottery(uint64 _index) onlyOwner; selects the winner using _getRandom
_getRandom(uint64 _range) public view; pseudo-random from block.difficulty and block.timestamp
getLotteryAddressPool(uint64 _index) view returns the addressPool array
msg.sender; caller address used as payer, balance holder and pool participant
block.timestamp; miner-influenceable value used as randomness entropy
external call tuskCoinV2.pay(msg.sender, _amount*price) executed before state updates
external call tusckCoinV1.burn(msg.sender, _amount*price) executed before state updates
weak randomness derived from block.difficulty and block.timestamp used to pick the lottery winner
